name: Filikod – ALT Text Audit & Bulk Editor
author: Filikod

sections.description:
Most WordPress websites have hidden ALT text issues.

• Missing ALT text
• Generic ALT like “image” or “logo”
• Duplicated ALT across multiple images
• ALT text that is too short

Search engines cannot fully understand your visuals.
Screen readers cannot properly describe them.

Filikod helps you detect and fix these problems directly inside your media library.

No AI.
No external API.
No complexity.

Just a clear audit and a powerful bulk ALT editor.

ALT Text Audit

Filikod scans your entire media library and detects:

• Missing ALT text
• Generic ALT descriptions
• Too short ALT text
• Duplicated ALT text

You get a global ALT Quality Score (0–100%) and a clear breakdown of issues.

You instantly understand the accessibility and SEO health of your images.

Bulk ALT Editor

Editing ALT text from the default media modal is slow.

Filikod allows you to:

• Edit ALT text inline
• Save changes instantly
• Filter by issue type
• Correct dozens of images in minutes

It is designed for freelancers, agencies and developers managing large media libraries.

Context Visibility

Writing a relevant ALT requires context.

Filikod shows where each image is used (post or page).
You can jump directly to the related content before editing.

This helps you write meaningful and accurate ALT descriptions.

Improve Accessibility & SEO

Proper ALT text helps:

• Screen readers describe content
• Search engines understand images
• Improve semantic relevance
• Support long-term SEO strategy

Learn more about ALT text best practices at https://filikod.com/

Compatibility

• Works with any theme
• Compatible with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WPBakery
• Single site and multisite compatible
• No external API required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate it
  3. Go to Filikod → Dashboard
  4. Review your ALT audit
  5. Start editing
sections.faq:
Does Filikod generate ALT text automatically?

No. Filikod focuses on audit and bulk manual editing to ensure full control.

Does it work on existing images?

Yes. It scans your entire media library.

Does it modify image files?

No. It only updates ALT attributes.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes. It works independently of your theme or builder.

More documentation available at https://filikod.com/

  • Initial public release
  • ALT automation (filename-based)

  • Image resizing on upload
  • Bulk processing for existing images
  • Secure SVG sanitization
  • Optional extended file types
  • Modern tab-based dashboard
